/* CGFK$DEFAULT_WHERE */
/* Add restrictive query on FK items if value(s) entered in non-table items */
/* and/or if there are items which may contain nulls as valid values. Code to */
/* restrict the query is added to the default where clause of the block. */
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 block_id Block := find_block('SDI');
 sub_where VARCHAR2(4000) := NULL;
 def_where VARCHAR2(4000) := NULL;
 r_string VARCHAR2(512) := NULL;

 FUNCTION add_and(
 P_WHERE IN VARCHAR2
 ) RETURN VARCHAR2 IS
 BEGIN
 IF (nvl( length(P_WHERE), 0) != 0) THEN
 RETURN( P_WHERE || ' AND ');
 ELSE
 RETURN( P_WHERE );
 END IF;
 END;

 BEGIN
 IF ( CG$LOV_SEA_DLVY_ITEMS_GLOBALS.SDI_WHERE = 'first_time') THEN
 CG$LOV_SEA_DLVY_ITEMS_GLOBALS.SDI_WHERE := get_block_property(block_id, DEFAULT_WHERE);
 END IF;
 def_where := CG$LOV_SEA_DLVY_ITEMS_GLOBALS.SDI_WHERE;

 sub_where := NULL;
 r_string := NAME_IN('SDI.LVBI_ITEM_MARK');
 IF (r_string IS NOT NULL) THEN
 BEGIN
 IF substr(r_string, 1,1) IN ('<','>','=') THEN
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(ITEM_MARK '|| r_string || ')';
 ELSIF substr(r_string, 1,1) ='#' THEN
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(ITEM_MARK '|| substr(r_string,2) || ')';
 ELSIF instr(r_string, '%') <> 0 THEN
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(ITEM_MARK LIKE '''|| replace(r_string,'''','''''') || ''')';
 ELSE
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(ITEM_MARK ='''|| replace(r_string,'''','''''') || ''')';
 END IF;
 END;
 END IF;
 IF (sub_where IS NOT NULL) THEN
 def_where := add_and( def_where ) || '((MFST_PORT_CD, MFST_NBR, MFST_DT, ITEM_SEQ, BL_SEQ, MFST_TYPE) IN '||'(SELECT PORT_CD, MFST_NBR, MFST_DT, ITEM_SEQ, BL_SEQ, MFST_TYPE '||'FROM VSSL_BL_ITEMS WHERE '|| sub_where || '))';
 END IF;

 set_block_property(block_id, DEFAULT_WHERE, def_where);

 EXCEPTION
 WHEN VALUE_ERROR THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(33, 'Query criteria too complex - simplify and re-query'), 'E', 'OFG', 33);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END;
END;

Trigger.Name: ON-ERROR
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGTE$BLK_LEVEL_ERROR_TRAP */
/* Trap errors returning from the server and report in a user friendly manner */
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 err_code CONSTANT NUMBER := ERROR_CODE;
 err_type CONSTANT VARCHAR2(3) := ERROR_TYPE;
 server_err NUMBER := abs(DBMS_ERROR_CODE);
 server_msg VARCHAR2(2000) := DBMS_ERROR_TEXT;
 constraint_name VARCHAR2(61);
 BEGIN
 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code IN (40506, 40508, 40509, 40510) ) THEN

 /* Remove recursive errors from the top of the stack */
 WHILE (server_err = 604) LOOP
 CGTE$POP_ERROR_STACK(server_err, server_msg);
 END LOOP;

 /* Check and report the generic constraint violations */
 IF ( CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO(server_err, server_msg) ) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* Check and report the constraint violations specific to this block */
 constraint_name := CGTE$STRIP_CONSTRAINT(server_msg);

 /* FK - Parent key not found */
 IF (server_err = 2291) THEN
 IF (constraint_name = 'SDI_VBI_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('هذا الصنف غير موجود', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSE
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* FK - Child record found */
 IF (server_err = 2292) THEN
 IF (err_code = 40509) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code = 40735 ) THEN


 /* Remove recursive errors from the top of the stack */
 WHILE (server_err = 604) LOOP
 CGTE$POP_ERROR_STACK(server_err, server_msg);
 END LOOP;

 /* If error not found, issue default message */
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(err_type||'-'||to_char(server_err)||': '||server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* If error not found, issue default message */
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(err_type||'-'||to_char(err_code)||': '||ERROR_TEXT, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;

 END;
END;

PROCEDURE Adjust_Width IS
 Shift number;
 ret number;
 ENTER_POS number;
 EXECUTE_POS number;
 OK_POS number;
 CANCEL_POS number;

BEGIN
 if :PARAMETER.WINDOW_WIDTH < 4 then
 ret := str.DispAlert('عرض القائمة أقل من الحد المسموح به','INFORMATION');
 elsif :PARAMETER.WINDOW_WIDTH > 7.5 then
 ret := str.DispAlert('عرض القائمة أكبر من الحد المسموح به','INFORMATION');
 else
 Shift := 1.75 - ((:PARAMETER.WINDOW_WIDTH - 4)/2);
 ENTER_POS := Get_Item_Property('PB_ENTER', X_POS);
 EXECUTE_POS := Get_Item_Property('PB_EXECUTE', X_POS);
 CANCEL_POS:= Get_Item_Property('PB_CANCEL', X_POS);
 OK_POS := Get_Item_Property('PB_OK', X_POS);

 Set_Item_Property('PB_ENTER', X_POS, ENTER_POS-Shift);
 Set_Item_Property('PB_EXECUTE', X_POS, EXECUTE_POS-Shift);
 Set_Item_Property('PB_CANCEL', X_POS, CANCEL_POS-Shift);
 Set_Item_Property('PB_OK', X_POS, OK_POS-Shift);

 Set_Window_Property('CGSO$WINDOW_1', WIDTH, :PARAMETER.WINDOW_WIDTH);
 Set_Canvas_Property('CG$PAGE_1', WIDTH, :PARAMETER.WINDOW_WIDTH);
 end if;
END;

PROCEDURE Adjust_Height IS
 V_HEIGHT number;
 SHIFT number;
 RET NUMBER;

BEGIN
 IF :PARAMETER.ROW_COUNT <= 12 THEN
 V_HEIGHT := Get_Window_Property('CGSO$WINDOW_1', HEIGHT);
 SHIFT := (12 - :PARAMETER.ROW_COUNT) * 0.25;

ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/* CGFK$QRY_SDI_SDI_VBI_FK */
PROCEDURE CGFK$QRY_SDI_SDI_VBI_FK(
 P_LVC_CNRNR_MRK IN OUT VARCHAR2 /* Value in Item :SDI.LVC_CNRNR_MRK. */
 ,P_L_VC_SHPG_AGNT_NBR IN OUT NUMBER /* Value in Item :SDI.L_VC_SHPG_AGNT_NBR. */
 ,P_L_VC_CNTNR_TYPE_CD IN OUT NUMBER /* Value in Item :SDI.L_VC_CNTNR_TYPE_CD. */
 ,P_L_VBI_CNTNR_SEQ IN OUT NUMBER /* Value in Item :SDI.L_VBI_CNTNR_SEQ. */
 ,P_L_VBI_PKG_TYPE_CD IN OUT NUMBER /* Value in Item :SDI.L_VBI_PKG_TYPE_CD. */
 ,P_L_VBI_GDS_TYPE_CD IN OUT NUMBER /* Value in Item :SDI.L_VBI_GDS_TYPE_CD. */
 ,P_LVBI_ITEM_MARK IN OUT VARCHAR2 /* Value in Item :SDI.LVBI_ITEM_MARK. */
 ,P_MFST_TYPE IN NUMBER /* Value in Item :SDI.MFST_TYPE. */
 ,P_BL_SEQ IN NUMBER /* Value in Item :SDI.BL_SEQ. */
 ,P_ITEM_SEQ IN NUMBER /* Value in Item :SDI.ITEM_SEQ. */
 ,P_MFST_DT IN DATE /* Value in Item :SDI.MFST_DT. */
 ,P_MFST_NBR IN NUMBER /* Value in Item :SDI.MFST_NBR. */
 ,P_MFST_PORT_CD IN NUMBER ) IS /* Value in Item :SDI.MFST_PORT_CD. */
/* Query foreign key value/query lookup data. */
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 CURSOR C IS
 SELECT L_VBI.ITEM_MARK
 ,L_VBI.GDS_TYPE_CD
 ,L_VBI.PKG_TYPE_CD
 ,L_VBI.CNTNR_SEQ
 ,L_VC.CNTNR_TYPE_CD
 ,L_VC.SHPG_AGNT_NBR
 ,L_VC.CNTNR_MRK
 FROM VSSL_BL_ITEMS L_VBI
 ,VSSL_CNTNRS L_VC
 WHERE L_VBI.PORT_CD = P_MFST_PORT_CD
 AND L_VBI.MFST_NBR = P_MFST_NBR
 AND L_VBI.MFST_DT = P_MFST_DT
 AND L_VBI.ITEM_SEQ = P_ITEM_SEQ
 AND L_VBI.BL_SEQ = P_BL_SEQ
 AND L_VBI.MFST_TYPE = P_MFST_TYPE
 AND L_VC.PORT_CD (+) = L_VBI.PORT_CD
 AND L_VC.CNTNR_SEQ (+) = L_VBI.CNTNR_SEQ
 AND L_VC.MFST_TYPE (+) = L_VBI.MFST_TYPE
 AND L_VC.MFST_NBR (+) = L_VBI.MFST_NBR
 AND L_VC.MFST_DT (+) = L_VBI.MFST_DT;
 BEGIN
 OPEN C;
 FETCH C
 INTO P_LVBI_ITEM_MARK
 , P_L_VBI_GDS_TYPE_CD
 , P_L_VBI_PKG_TYPE_CD
 , P_L_VBI_CNTNR_SEQ
 , P_L_VC_CNTNR_TYPE_CD
 , P_L_VC_SHPG_AGNT_NBR
 , P_LVC_CNRNR_MRK;
 IF C%NOTFOUND THEN
 CLOSE C;
 RAISE NO_DATA_FOUND;
 END IF;
 CLOSE C;
 END;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/* CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO */
FUNCTION CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO(
 P_SERVER_ERR IN NUMBER /* Server error message */
 ,P_SERVER_MSG IN VARCHAR2) /* Server error number */
RETURN BOOLEAN IS
/* Check and report Primary/Unique Key, Check Constraint and User */
/* Defined Constraint violations */
 constraint_name VARCHAR2(61); /* Violated constraint */
BEGIN
 /* Check if the error code is one we are interested in */
 IF ( NOT (P_SERVER_ERR IN (1, 2290) OR
 (P_SERVER_ERR >= 20000 AND P_SERVER_ERR <= 20999) ) )
 THEN
 RETURN( FALSE );
 END IF;

 /* Deal with user defined errors */
 IF (P_SERVER_ERR >= 20000 AND P_SERVER_ERR <= 20999) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(''||CGTE$STRIP_FIRST_ERROR(P_SERVER_MSG), 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 RETURN( TRUE );
 END IF;

 /* Deal with Primary/Unique Key and Check Constraint violations */
 constraint_name := CGTE$STRIP_CONSTRAINT(P_SERVER_MSG);
 IF (P_SERVER_ERR = 1) THEN
 IF (constraint_name = 'SVCNTNR_UK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('عفوا..سبق تسجيل نفس العلامة المميزة للحاوية على نفس المانفيست', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSE
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(P_SERVER_MSG, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 ELSIF (P_SERVER_ERR = 2290) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(P_SERVER_MSG, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 RETURN( TRUE );
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: GET_SITEM_REMAINS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE GET_SITEM_REMAINS(V_WT OUT NUMBER, V_PKG OUT NUMBER) IS
 V_DCLTN_ISN NUMBER;
 V_CNT NUMBER;
 V_DGT_WT NUMBER;
 V_SDI_WT NUMBER;
 V_DGT_PKG NUMBER;
 V_SDI_PKG NUMBER;
BEGIN
 V_WT := NULL;
 V_PKG := NULL;

 V_SDI_WT := :SDI.DLVRD_WT;
 V_SDI_PKG := :SDI.DLVRD_QTY;

 BEGIN
 SELECT DCLTN_ISN
 INTO V_DCLTN_ISN
 FROM SEA_DLVY_ORDERS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :PARAMETER.P_PORT_CD
 AND SHPG_AGNT_NBR = :PARAMETER.P_SHPG_AGNT_NBR
 AND DO_NBR = :PARAMETER.P_DO_NBR
 AND DO_ISS_DT = :PARAMETER.P_DO_ISS_DT
 ;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 V_WT := V_SDI_WT;
 V_PKG := V_SDI_PKG;
 RETURN;
 END;

 BEGIN
 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO V_CNT
 FROM DCLTN_GATE_TRANS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :PARAMETER.P_PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = V_DCLTN_ISN
 AND DGT_TYPE = 1
 ;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 V_CNT := 0;
 END;

 IF NVL(V_CNT, 0) <> 0 THEN
 V_WT := 0;
 V_PKG := 0;
 RETURN;
 END IF;

 BEGIN
 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO V_CNT
 FROM DCLTN_GATE_TRANS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :PARAMETER.P_PORT_CD
 AND SEA_SHPG_AGNT_NBR = :PARAMETER.P_SHPG_AGNT_NBR
 AND SEA_DLVY_NBR = :PARAMETER.P_DO_NBR
 AND SEA_DLVY_DT = :PARAMETER.P_DO_ISS_DT
 AND DGT_TYPE = 2
 ;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 V_CNT := 0;
 END;

 IF NVL(V_CNT, 0) <> 0 THEN
 V_WT := 0;
 V_PKG := 0;
 RETURN;
 END IF;

 BEGIN
 SELECT SUM(CLRD_WT), SUM(CLRD_QTY)
 INTO V_DGT_WT, V_DGT_PKG
 FROM DCLTN_GATE_TRANS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :PARAMETER.P_PORT_CD
 AND SEA_SHPG_AGNT_NBR = :PARAMETER.P_SHPG_AGNT_NBR
 AND SEA_DLVY_NBR = :PARAMETER.P_DO_NBR
 AND SEA_DLVY_DT = :PARAMETER.P_DO_ISS_DT
 AND SEA_ITEM_SEQ = :SDI.PRCSD_ITEM_SEQ
 AND DGT_TYPE IN (3, 5)
 ;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 V_DGT_WT := 0;
 V_DGT_PKG := 0;
 END;
 V_DGT_WT := NVL(V_DGT_WT , 0);
 V_DGT_PKG := NVL(V_DGT_PKG, 0);

 V_WT := V_SDI_WT - V_DGT_WT;
 V_PKG := V_SDI_PKG - V_DGT_PKG;

END;

ProgramUnit.Name: COPY_SELECTED_VALUES
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE COPY_SELECTED_VALUES IS
MSG_LVL VARCHAR2(5);
BEGIN
 :GLOBAL.SDI_SEL := NULL;
 LAST_RECORD;
 LOOP
 IF :SDI.CHK = 1 THEN
 IF :GLOBAL.SDI_SEL IS NULL THEN
 :GLOBAL.SDI_SEL := :SDI.PRCSD_ITEM_SEQ;
 ELSE
 :GLOBAL.SDI_SEL := :GLOBAL.SDI_SEL || ',' || :SDI.PRCSD_ITEM_SEQ;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 EXIT WHEN GET_BLOCK_PROPERTY('SDI', CURRENT_RECORD) = 1;
 PREVIOUS_RECORD;
 END LOOP;

 MSG_LVL := :SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL;
 :SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL := '25';
 DO_KEY('exit_form');
 DO_KEY('exit_form');
 :SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL := MSG_LVL;
END;

Trigger.Name: ON-ERROR
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGAP$TES_SEQUENCE_BEFORE */
 DECLARE
 errnum NUMBER := ERROR_CODE;
 errtxt VARCHAR2(80) := ERROR_TEXT;
 errtyp VARCHAR2(20) := ERROR_TYPE;
 alert_is alert;
 alert_button number;
 MsgTxt VARCHAR2(2000);

 BEGIN
 IF errnum = 41051 then
 null;
 else
 IF errtyp = 'FRM' THEN
 errtyp := 'خطأ : ش';
 ELSIF errtyp = 'ORA' THEN
 errtyp := 'خطأ : ق';
 END IF;

 IF DBMS_ERROR_CODE = ERR_DB.GET_DB_ERR_CD THEN
 MsgTxt := ERR_DB.GET_LAST_ERROR;
 ELSE
 MsgTxt := errtyp||'-'||TO_CHAR(errnum)||': '||errtxt;
 END IF;
 alert_is := find_alert('CFG_ERROR');

 if (not id_null(alert_is)) then
 set_alert_property(alert_is, ALERT_MESSAGE_TEXT, MsgTxt );
 alert_button := show_alert(alert_is);
 else
 Message(MsgTxt);
 end if;

 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
end if;
 END;
